626 Yacht Services  Brand Style Guide02

About this guide

One identity, from dock to driveway.

This guide covers the basics of the 626 Yacht Services identity: the logo, the color palette, the typeface, and how they come together on the things people actually see: crew wear, business cards and service vehicles.

Follow it and everything carrying the name will look like it came from the same crew.

Working files

Always place the logo from the master artwork files. Never rebuild it, trace it, or lift it from a screenshot or from this document.

626 Yacht Services  Brand Style GuideLogo  03

Logo

The primary mark

Three numerals drawn as one continuous form. The 6, 2 and 6 pass through each other like links in an anchor chain, and Signature Gold picks out the crossings.

Use the primary logo wherever there's room, on white or Coastal Ice. It's fixed artwork: the numerals, the wordmark and the space between them always travel together.

  • Monogram

    The 626 numerals in Yacht Blue, drawn as one interlocking shape.

  • Crossings

    Signature Gold marks where the forms cross. Never recolor or remove it.

  • Wordmark

    YACHT SERVICES in widely tracked capitals, centered under the monogram.

Logo

Logo versions

Pick the version by the background it sits on. Full color comes first; one-color versions are for single-ink jobs like stamps, engraving, etched glass and cut vinyl.

Primary

Full color on white or Coastal Ice. The default.

Reversed

Coastal Ice and Gold on Yacht Blue or Obsidian.

Monogram

Numerals only, for caps, sleeves, avatars and tight spaces. On square formats, center it with clear space.

One-color, Yacht Blue

Single-ink print, embossing and engraving on light materials.

One-color, Coastal Ice

Single color on dark fields: cut vinyl, screen print, etched glass.

Monogram, reversed

Numerals only on Yacht Blue or Obsidian.

Logo

Clear space & minimum size

Clear space is measured in X, the cap height of YACHT SERVICES, so it scales with the logo. Keep at least 2X free of text, edges and other graphics on every side.

X
2X
2X
2X
2X

X = cap height of the wordmark at whatever size the logo is placed.

The monogram uses the same rule: 2X, taken from the full lockup at the same width.

Minimum size

  • Full lockup1.5 in38 mm print160 pxscreen
  • Monogram0.5 in13 mm print48 pxscreen

Shown at actual size when printed

Below the full-lockup minimum, the wordmark stops reading. Switch to the monogram instead of shrinking further.

626 Yacht Services  Brand Style GuideLogo  06

Logo

Logo misuse

The logo only works when it's left alone. These are the mistakes that come up most often in the field. If a layout seems to call for one of them, change the layout, not the logo.

Don't stretch or squeeze it

Scale proportionally, always.

Don't swap or change the colors

Gold stays on the crossings. No new colors.

Don't put the primary on dark fields

Use the reversed version instead.

Don't add effects

No shadows, outlines, glows, bevels or gradients.

Don't rotate or tilt it

The logo sits level, even on curved surfaces.

Yacht Services

Don't retype the wordmark

Use the artwork; never set it in another font.

626 Yacht Services  Brand Style GuideApplications  10

Applications

Apparel

  • PlacementLeft chest, full lockup, level with the second button.
  • Size3.5–4 in wide. Smaller than that, the wordmark won't stitch cleanly.
  • Small spotsMonogram only on caps, sleeves and cuffs.
  • Dark garmentsReversed logo: Coastal Ice numerals and wordmark, Gold crossings.
  • ThreadMatch to the palette swatches and approve a stitch-out before the run.
626 Yacht Services  Brand Style GuideApplications  11

Applications

Business cards

  • Format3.5 × 2 in, US standard.
  • Two finishesPrimary logo on a white card; reversed logo on an Obsidian card. Both keep 2X clear space.
  • TypeJost throughout. Name in Medium, title and contact details in Regular at 7–8 pt.
  • StockHeavy uncoated or soft-touch stock, 16 pt or heavier, for the texture shown.
  • ColorPrint from the CMYK values and request a proof. Gold shifts the most between stocks.
626 Yacht Services  Brand Style GuideApplications  12

Applications

Vehicle wrap

Mockup for visualization. Final layout drawn to the vehicle template.

Layout

Obsidian body and a white door panel, divided by one Signature Gold sweep. One gold line only.

Logo

Primary logo on the white panel, clear of handles, seams and the fuel door by at least 2X.

Production

Cast wrap vinyl with laminate. Check Gold against a printed swatch in daylight before install.
